subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: While no merge base is required for it, the structure arm shall register as a base-free self-registered docgate check that adds no hand-edited line to the umbrella enumeration, dispatch, or help.
fit_criterion: the arm ships as a single `reg_*.go` descriptor (`NeedsMergeBase: false`); the umbrella/dispatch/help gain no hand-edited line (diff inspection); it runs on every gate path
